full_name: 100-item visual acuity survey (yes/no everyday-task items linked to acuity demand)
domains: single construct: acuity-linked everyday visual tasks (item difficulties span ~0.15-1.47 logMAR)
scoring: IRT two-parameter logistic model; ability theta mapped to VA by VA = 0.59 - 0.33 x theta (Equation 1); single items/sets screened with No = positive
target_population: adults 18+ across a broad VA range
notes: Development and validation reported in ref 7 (not this paper). Five items had suboptimal IRT fit (p3). Full item list in Supplementary Material (not in text); Table 5 p6 gives wording of the 22 featured items. Time and administration mode NR here.
